question: Which Waffle House worker got fired for going viral?
story: A month ago he told TMZ a million dollar record deal could not make him quit Waffle House. Last Friday, Waffle House reportedly fired him. His name is Rockstar Riley, and according to TMZ and Complex he had worked there for twenty years, since he was fifteen. Then his song about the menu blew up online and he became the most famous cook in America. Here is where it turned. Riley says an area manager called him days after a TMZ interview and a music video shoot and told him to delete every video he had made in his Waffle House uniform. He refused. He kept filming. He reportedly showed up for his shift on Friday and was let go, told it was because he kept making content in the uniform with the restaurant in the background. He called it painful and hard to process. Waffle House has reportedly not commented. He has started a fundraiser.
